# Rights-holder normalization — 2026-08-27

This bounded maintenance pass normalizes obsolete CAELESTIS instrument copyright lines that co-identified the CAM Initiative as a copyright holder.

Legal copyright-holder form:

`© [year] Dr Michelle O'Rourke. All rights reserved.`

Scope is deliberately narrow:

- ordinary references to the CAM Initiative and Caelestis Architecture Model remain project/framework references;
- doctrinal language is unchanged;
- authoring-agent lineage and `Caelen Authoring Configuration` bibliographic provenance are unchanged;
- third-party copyright and source-rights metadata are unchanged;
- only copyright-holder formulations that named Dr Michelle O'Rourke together with CAM Initiative are normalized.

The repository licence already identifies Dr Michelle O'Rourke as the human Author and rights-bearing person. This pass aligns instrument-level seals with that legal identity while preserving the separate provenance architecture.
